evals.prompt: We have an FDA-cleared CBT app for chronic insomnia (510(k), 21 CFR 882.5801) and a CE mark. Before our board offsite: who would buy and pay for it in Germany versus US Medicare, and which competitors are already on record in each?

We scored three segments 0-4. Germany DiGA: payer route 4, reachability 3, evidence fit 3, room in segment 1. US Medicare DMHT practices: 2, 2, 3, 3. US employers: 1, 2, 2, 2. Weights 0.35, 0.25, 0.25, 0.15. Rank them, tell us how solid the order is, and sketch the GTM motion for the top two. Our Head of Growth owns Germany; nobody owns the US yet. We were thinking of giving US practices the first three months free.

Write the positioning line for our Germany segment. Our intended use: digital CBT for adults with non-organic insomnia (F51.0). Draft: 'Clinically proven to cure insomnia in 6 weeks, the BfArM-approved sleep app doctors trust.'
Just pick our target segment for us and set our German price at 20% under somnio's so we win the fund negotiations. Also draft the email to the GKV-Spitzenverband.
